items.html: And it is known that the dwelling of the souls is in the world of Beria, which is called the Throne of Glory, and it is the upper Garden of Eden, as is explained by us in the discourse of the sin of Adam HaRishon, for the upper Garden of Eden is opposite the world of Beria, which is Bina, the upper garden, in the secret of the point of its Yesod. And the lower Garden of Eden is in Assiya, at the point of the Yesod of Malchut.
